0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000010_YDA
0.description: We're here! Did we miss anything?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: We would not presume to begin without you, Yda.<hex:02100103>Urianger has returned to the Waking Sands, but everyone else is now present.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000030_ALISAIE
2.description: Yes, but for <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>, exactly? We all have duties to attend to, Alphinaud, so you may dispense with the preamble.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: Thank you, Alisaie. It is the very subject of those duties which compelled me to call this gathering. Though the Warriors of Darkness no longer pose a threat, Eorzea's many troubles demand no less of our attention.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: And while I stand by the decision to approach each task as we see fit, I fear our effectiveness will ultimately be diminished should we continue to act in ignorance of each other's efforts. Thus I propose we elect a successor to Minfilia─not to serve as a fully fledged Antecedent, perhaps, but as a coordinator of operations.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000060_ALISAIE
5.description: Is that all? Then the decision seems clear.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000070_ALISAIE
6.description: No one else has shown any enthusiasm for the role. And judging by your performance at our previous meeting, you would seem the perfect candidate. You always did have a flair for politics.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: I-I did not mean to─ That was not my intention.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: As my tenure as commander of the Crystal Braves comprehensively demonstrated, I lack the qualities required for such an office. I would much prefer to remain as I am now─a soldier in the field, so to speak.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000100_YSHTOLA
9.description: Should none of our number step forward, must we then constrain some unwilling candidate to take up the position?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000110_THANCRED
10.description: Well, based on merit alone, a certain adventurer would be my choice─though I concede <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> might struggle to balance <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> new responsibilities with, let me see...slaying primals, thwarting legatuses, and feeding the orphaned poor.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000120_PAPALYMO
11.description: Thancred makes a good point. Any who would wear such a mantle would be bound by its obligations. Have we not become sufficiently familiar with each other's methods to act without an overseer? At present, I see no cause to so willingly limit one of our number.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000130_TATARU
12.description: Oh! Oh, my goodness! You're─ Help! I need some help here!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000150_TATARU
14.description: <hex:021A020203>Me<hex:021A020103>!? I'm fine! It's this poor girl who just staggered in and collapsed on the floor that I'm worried about!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000160_YDA
15.description: Naago!? Gods, how did─ Y'shtola, please, you have to help her!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000170_YSHTOLA
16.description: Krile, a hand if you would. Let us see about closing these wounds.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000180_KRILE
17.description: Now, we've staunched the bleeding, but it may be a while before you can move about again. Though, having seen your wounds, I'm surprised you were still moving at all...

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000190_MNAAGO
18.description: Thank you... My message... It was too important to delay.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000200_MNAAGO
19.description: I took the shortest route I could, though I knew it was more heavily patrolled... As you can see, my efforts at evasion were not entirely successful.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000210_YDA
20.description: Honestly, you're too brave for your own good! What was so urgent that you needed to fight half the Empire to get here? You could have been killed!

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000220_MNAAGO
21.description: I'm sorry, Yda. I had good reason... Ah, but I imagine your friends are wondering who this bloody mess of a Miqo'te is. My name is M'naago, and I belong to the Ala Mhigan Resistance.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000230_MNAAGO
22.description: I came to warn Yda and Papalymo about one of our leaders─a man who calls himself the Griffin. He's always been dangerous, but he's planning something new...something reckless.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000240_THANCRED
23.description: The Griffin, you say? I've heard the name. Rumor has it, your man is eager to test his claws.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000250_MNAAGO
24.description: Aye, and on no easy target. He means to assault Baelsar's Wall from the Ala Mhigan side.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000260_PAPALYMO
25.description: But what does the Griffin possibly hope to gain from such an attack?

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000270_MNAAGO
26.description: From what I understand, he wants the fires of war to spread to Eorzea. And for that, he needs to control the border with Gridania.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000280_ALPHINAUD
27.description: ...So he means to spark a conflict between the Alliance and the imperial forces stationed in Ala Mhigo─to have Eorzea's armies aid in the liberation effort, whether they will it or no.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000290_PAPALYMO
28.description: His plan is flawed. Even should the Resistance succeed in occupying the Wall, they would not be able to hold it. Imperial reinforcements would drive them out within a week!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000300_KRILE
29.description: Be that as it may, if there is even a chance that this scheme could bring about an escalation in hostilities between Eorzea and the Empire, the Alliance must be informed.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000310_YSHTOLA
30.description: Agreed. I shall depart for Limsa Lominsa forthwith and seek an audience with the Admiral. Thancred─Ul'dah is yours.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000320_YSHTOLA
31.description: Alphinaud and Alisaie─make haste to the Twelveswood, and notify the Elder Seedseer of the danger to Gridania. She will duly call a council of the Alliance leaders, whom you must be ready to receive.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000330_YSHTOLA
32.description: You will be our voice in Ishgard. Explain the situation to Ser Aymeric, and encourage him to send an envoy.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000340_YSHTOLA
33.description: Tataru, Krile─I leave the care of our injured messenger to you. See that she remains quiescent and her wounds closed.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000350_YSHTOLA
34.description: I believe that covers everything. Let us be about our tasks.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000360_PAPALYMO
35.description: I suspect the ill tidings from Gyr Abania will be held as a turning point─the beginning to a bloody end.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000370_PAPALYMO
36.description: The business of war was ever conducted with the coin of self-sacrifice.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000380_PAPALYMO
37.description: 'Twas Master Louisoix himself who taught us that such costs are not to be ignored or denied.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000390_PAPALYMO
38.description: And so I shall embrace them. When the time comes, I will make my choice─as you will yours.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000400_KANESENNA
39.description: I bid you welcome, my friends. As you will by now be aware, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have come into possession of certain intelligence concerning recent developments in the region of Gyr Abania. It springs, I am assured, from an unimpeachable source─is that not so, Master Alphinaud?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000410_ALPHINAUD
40.description: Indeed, Elder Seedseer. Our information comes directly from a member of the Resistance's inner circle, and we have no cause to doubt its veracity.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000420_RAUBAHN
41.description: This “Griffin” of theirs is a fool if he thinks he can hold Baelsar's Wall against the Empire.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000430_RAUBAHN
42.description: When the imperials move to take it back, they will come in force─and the resulting fighting is all but certain to spill over into the Black Shroud...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000440_KANESENNA
43.description: At the Battle of Carteneau, the combined might of three Grand Companies labored to contend with the remnants of but a single imperial legion.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000450_KANESENNA
44.description: Alone, Gridania would be hard-pressed indeed to hold back the tide should the Garleans turn their minds from reclamation to invasion.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000460_AYMERIC
45.description: May I once more convey my nation's deepest regrets for our inaction in the days prior to the Calamity. 'Tis a stain upon our ledger that I would fain remove.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000470_AYMERIC
46.description: Elder Seedseer─I do hereby request leave to deploy a defensive force within the borders of Gridania. Ishgard's return to the Alliance shall be honored by more than mere ink upon parchment.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000480_YUGIRI
47.description: The Doman people, too, would join any effort that weakens our common foe. We are few, but our most seasoned shinobi are at your disposal.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000490_KANESENNA
48.description: On behalf of my people, I offer you my humble thanks. Gridania welcomes your assistance.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000500_RAUBAHN
49.description: It is time we set our contingency plans in motion. Is the Alliance agreed?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000510_RAUBAHN
50.description: Then let us make ready for war. Victory favors the swift, and there is much to be done.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000520_ALISAIE
51.description: The council knows that Ala Mhigo will not soon be wrested from the Empire, and its decision to bolster the border's defenses seems eminently practical. Why, then, Brother, do you scowl so?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000530_ALPHINAUD
52.description: I agree that they have chosen the wisest course available. Indeed, the only reasonable one.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000540_ALPHINAUD
53.description: Yet something feels awry. In making ready for war, is the Alliance not granting the Griffin the very thing he desired? Any attempt to hold the Wall is doomed to failure, aye, but I wonder if we have misjudged the prize for which he plays...

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000551_ILBERD
55.description: But you cannot stop what I've begun. Behold─a glimpse of things to come!

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000560_SOLDIERA02354
56.description: We did it! We showed the bastards!

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000580_SOLDIERC02354
58.description: And who knows, lads? Mayhap the Eorzeans'll finally see sense...when the enemy turns up on their <hex:021A020203>bloody doorstep<hex:021A020103>!

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000590_LAURENTIUS
59.description: This is for Ala Mhigo... For Eorzea...

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000600_LAURENTIUS
60.description: They die, that others may live...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000630_SOLDIERB02354
63.description: War machines... How did they get here so quickly!?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000640_SOLDIERA02354
64.description: S-Stand your ground! For the Resistance!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000650_SOLDIERC02354
65.description: There's nowhere to run! We're cut off!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000670_SOLDIERA02354
67.description: Gods help us... What were we thinking? The Empire's too big... Too powerful...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000700_ALPHINAUD
70.description: As you can see, our infiltrators did not elude me for long. Lady Yugiri is sending for an airship even as we speak.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000710_YDA
71.description: What do we do!? This is a massacre!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000720_ILBERD
72.description: Heh heh heh heh... How wonderful to see you...<hex:021A020203>Commander<hex:021A020103>.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000740_ALPHINAUD
74.description: This has to end! It has to end <hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>! Do you not see your countrymen dying? Have your ideals rendered you blind even to that!? Order the retreat, and we will help your soldiers to safety!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000750_ILBERD
75.description: <hex:021A020203>Retreat<hex:021A020103>? With the moment of my triumph so close at hand? You truly are a sheltered child, Leveilleur.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000760_ALPHINAUD
76.description: Nidhogg's eyes! ...No abyss is too deep for you, I see. But trust me when I say that such power was not meant for mortal hands!

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000770_ILBERD
77.description: How long have I struggled to reach this point! My countrymen so inured to the taste of defeat, they no longer balk at its bitterness. Shouting my throat raw with rallying cries, only to be greeted with dull eyes and blank faces!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000780_ILBERD
78.description: My “brothers” and “sisters” in Ul'dah have surrendered to their apathy and their appetites. Were it not for the glint of Lolorito's coin, I doubt even those here now would have answered my call!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000790_ILBERD
79.description: "Take back our homeland! Free Ala Mhigo!“ Hah! They'll happily mouth the words, but they won't spill the blood!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000800_ILBERD
80.description: You say no mortal should wield these eyes? Then I shall gladly become a demon! I will suckle on the souls of the hopeless, and liberate the homeland they no longer deserve!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000810_ALPHINAUD
81.description: What exactly do you mean to do...?

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000820_ILBERD
82.description: Did you hear their cries as victory was snatched away from them? Even with their dying breaths they cursed the Empire! Never has their desire for vengeance been so raw, so true! A god has no need of faith when <hex:021A020203>summoned<hex:021A020103> by so pure a purpose!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000840_ALPHINAUD
84.description: You cannot mean to fight the Empire with a primal! You know full well the danger─the <hex:021A020203>futility<hex:021A020103> of relying on such power!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000850_ILBERD
85.description: Oh, yes, I know their limitations─which is why I will call upon a deity more terrible than the very black wyrm of the Calamity itself!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000880_ILBERD
88.description: An ending to mark a new beginning...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000890_ILBERD
90.description: An ending to mark a new beginning... My pain! My longing! You shall have it all!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000910_PAPALYMO
93.description: His death completed the ritual. The primal is taking shape.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000920_YDA
94.description: Well, can't we stop it!? There must be something we can do!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000940_YDA
96.description: Wha─? Hey! Where do you think you're going!?

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000950_PAPALYMO
97.description: Master Louisoix briefly contained Bahamut by means of a potent spell of sealing. I will now attempt to do the same.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000960_ALPHINAUD
98.description: But that's impossible! We would need hours to collect the necessary aether, i-if not days!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000970_PAPALYMO
99.description: Ah, Alphinaud... Though I concede it may not always be apparent, I was ever your grandsire's finest pupil.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000980_ALPHINAUD
100.description: Tupsimati, of course! The staff still holds enormous power, broken or not.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_000990_YDA
101.description: Don't you dare, Papalymo! I know how that spell works!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001010_PAPALYMO
103.description: Quite right! Quickly, now! Off you go! The further away the better!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001020_YDA
104.description: No! If you're staying, then so am I!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001030_PAPALYMO
105.description: No, Yda! There is a path only you can walk, and it must not end here─not like this!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001040_PAPALYMO
106.description: Take her! Please, you have to take her!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001060_YDA
108.description: Wha─ No! Damn it, Thancred! Put me down! Thancred!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001070_PAPALYMO
109.description: This is one battle you cannot fight. Away with you. Go!

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
111.description: Trust in Papalymo and leave on the airship.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001080_THANCRED
113.description: Hilda! I think he means now!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001090_PAPALYMO
114.description: I bid thee farewell again, my dear Yda...

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001091_PAPALYMO
115.description: Now, let us see how good a student I truly was...

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001100_GOSETSU
116.description: (-Towering Traveler-)A word if you would, good sir. This place, it is within the realm of Eorzea?

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001110_PASSER02356
117.description: You're an odd-looking fellow, aren't you? Still...takes all sorts, I s'pose. This here's Vesper Bay─“Thanalan's door to the ocean,” as some folk like to call it...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001120_GOSETSU
118.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Am I to understand from your answer that I have indeed arrived in Eorzea?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001140_GOSETSU
120.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Ah, a plain response at last! And the one I wanted, at that! My journey was not without its hardships, and I would sooner travel by land than put to sea again!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001150_GOSETSU
121.description: (-Towering Traveler-)You do not believe that so small a bark could bear me across the ocean? Such timid little sailors! I had but to set my course, then set my jaw till I made port!

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001160_GOSETSU
122.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Hah hah hah hah hah hah hah!

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001170_GOSETSU
123.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Though...'twould perhaps have been wise to lay down my oars a moment to sup on more than the spray of brinewater. By the trembling of my limbs, I sense a brief repast may be in order...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001180_GOSETSU
124.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Nay! I will not hearken to the feeble grumblings of an empty belly! Duty comes before all!

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001190_PASSER02356
125.description: Good gods, man! Are you all right?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001200_URIANGER
126.description: Thou art far indeed from home, friend...

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001210_KANESENNA
127.description: Dear friends...pray accept my heartfelt thanks for your efforts in defense of Gridania's borders. I would fain dwell longer on my gratitude for the support of the Alliance, but the situation at Baelsar's Wall demands that we forgo such pleasantries.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001220_BODYGUARD01623
128.description: According to our most recent intelligence, the cocoon of light that formed in the air above the Wall remains undimmed and unbroken.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001230_BODYGUARD01623
129.description: After measuring the cocoon's aetheric concentrations, Archon Y'shtola has confirmed the presence of a primal entity...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001240_RAUBAHN
130.description: Hmph. So we must assume that Ilberd's thrice-damned god is indeed trapped within. And what news of the imperials? They are not like to ignore such a spectacle.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001250_BODYGUARD01623
131.description: Sir. A Garlean airship was observed making an approach, but the vessel was destroyed when it drew near. The Empire appears to have made no subsequent attempts to reach the object.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001260_KANESENNA
132.description: The soldiers who witnessed the incident spoke of a “lance of light” issuing from within the cocoon. Of an entire warship being reduced to smoking ruin in the space of a moment...

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001270_KANESENNA
133.description: Veterans of Carteneau, meanwhile...likened the destruction to that wrought by the fiery wrath of Bahamut.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001290_ALPHINAUD
135.description: So the primal is awake, then? Contained, yes, but for how long? We must destroy it now, lest it break free!

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001300_CID
136.description: Agreed. There is, however, the small matter of how to get close enough to a being that swats warships from the sky as you would a bothersome gnat...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001310_NERO
137.description: (-???-)Is this truly so complex a puzzle? Or have you no <hex:021A020203>stomach<hex:021A020103> for the obvious solution?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001320_CID
138.description: What in the hells are <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> doing here!?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001330_NERO
139.description: A pleasure to see you too, Garlond. Now, if you would be so kind as to explain to these good people why you should be <hex:021A020203>begging me<hex:021A020103> for my assistance, that would be most appreciated.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001350_NERO
141.description: Oh, how terrifically rude of me! Nero tol Scaeva, former tribunus of the XIVth Legion of the Garlean Empire. These days, however, one might say that I am something of a free agent.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001370_NERO
143.description: I was <hex:021A020203>getting<hex:021A020103> to that. Although you already know what I am about to propose, old friend.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001380_NERO
144.description: As you have rather belatedly realized, within that frail binding lurks an entity alike in strength to the great Bahamut. And the only force in existence which might conceivably contend with such a foe is the very creation which captured the elder primal in the first place. I speak, of course, of Omega.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001390_RAUBAHN
145.description: Omega!? That hulk has been gathering dust beneath the plains of Carteneau since the Allagans breathed their last! And none alive knows how to wake it.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001400_NERO
146.description: I'm sorry─do you understand who it is with whom you have the privilege of speaking? I am Nero tol Scaeva, master engineer─the mechanical genius who restored the Ultima Weapon to full operational capacity!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001410_NERO
147.description: And, as luck would have it, I am graciously offering you the use of my considerable expertise.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001420_CID
148.description: And, what, you just expect us to accept? Why would we trust the word of a man who furnished the Black Wolf with the means to subjugate Eorzea?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001430_CID
149.description: And, what, you just expect us to accept? You're a fool if you think your deeds at the Crystal Tower were enough to win my trust, Nero.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001440_NERO
150.description: Trust? You wound me, Garlond! All those years studying side by side at the Academy, sharing both trial and triumph. We were countrymen, once, you and I.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001450_NERO
151.description: But sentiment aside─have you a better solution? Or do you mean to send in your vaunted hero there, as you always do, and pray the world is not engulfed in flame?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001460_NERO
152.description: Let us approach the problem in a rational manner. Does not the fact that Omega slumbers in stasis point to the existence of some overriding technology? A means of control?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001470_KANESENNA
153.description: I would ask a question, if I may─Nero, was it not? In the event that we succeeded in using Omega to shackle the primal in the manner you propose, what then would become of it? Do we not risk repeating the mistakes of the Allagans?

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001480_NERO
154.description: Omega is but a tool. How we choose to employ that tool is entirely up to us. Of course, if you would rather leave it buried beneath Carteneau while you continue your petty squabbles above, then I suppose that is also your choice.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001490_CID
155.description: Spare us, Nero! The Seedseer's concern is a valid one. He who controls Omega wields the power of the gods. The very power which led the Allagans to destroy themselves.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001500_NERO
156.description: And does it not fall to we engineers to prevent such misuse? What was your company's proud slogan? “Freedom through Technology”?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001510_CID
157.description: Hah. A creed you follow, is it?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001520_CID
158.description: <sigh> What say you? Do we take this villain at his word?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
161.description: No, but I'll keep an eye on him.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001530_CID
162.description: He makes me grind my teeth is what he does, but I suppose we don't have much of a choice.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001540_CID
163.description: ...As will I. I don't like it, but then it doesn't look like we have much choice.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001550_CID
164.description: Would the council be willing to entrust this matter to a pair of former imperials?

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001560_KANESENNA
165.description: Yes. The task of restoring the Allagan relic will be yours. But the responsibility for its reawakening must remain with the council. Do we condone this course of action?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001570_RAUBAHN
166.description: Aye. 'Twould seem we do. Let the records show that we invest this contingent with the authority to enter Carteneau and take command of Omega.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001580_RAUBAHN
167.description: Cid, I appoint you leader of the expedition. Scions─I would ask that you assign some few of your number to escort Master Garlond and supervise the other one.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001590_ALPHINAUD
168.description: We should be happy to oblige. The politics of Carteneau being what they are, I daresay our neutrality will prove useful in avoiding any unnecessary entanglements.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001600_ALISAIE
169.description: If I am not mistaken, Doma occupies a similarly neutral position. Might we not persuade you to join the expedition, Lady Yugiri? If you suspected any foul play from Nero, you would be welcome to kill him.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001620_NERO
171.description: Not a moment's hesitation, eh? You'll forgive me if I do not shake your hand.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001630_NERO
172.description: Hm. So these are the fabled headquarters of the Scions... I confess, I would have expected an order of self-proclaimed warrior-scholars to surround themselves with the fruits of man's enlightenment. And yet there is not so much as a single piece of magitek in sight.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001640_NERO
173.description: It never ceases to amaze me how primitive you Eorzeans truly are...

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001650_TATARU
174.description: Hmph! I'll have you know that the Rising Stones is home to the very latest in magitek innovation.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001660_TATARU
175.description: Wedge calls it the “Mark XIV Thermocoil Boilmaster,” and it's the finest kettle I've ever had the pleasure to own.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001680_ALPHINAUD
177.description: Well, Yda and I, at least. Y'shtola and the others remained behind to continue their assessment of the binding magick.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001690_YDA
178.description: There didn't seem much point staying just for that, so I decided to come back with Alphinaud. Papalymo bought us this time. We shouldn't waste it.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001710_ALISAIE
180.description: Good gods. That voice could fell a gigas...

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001720_GOSETSU
181.description: (-Towering Traveler-)This is the Rising Stones, domicile of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn? I enter at the invitation of one Lord Urianger!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001730_GOSETSU
182.description: (-Towering Traveler-)Ho-ho! I spy you there, shadow walker. You always were a hard one to find!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001740_ALISAIE
183.description: Yugiri...? Do you know this man?

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001750_YUGIRI
184.description: Gosetsu!? Why are you come to Eorzea?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001760_GOSETSU
185.description: In search of you, Yugiri! For days and nights did I row across the angry sea...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001770_GOSETSU
186.description: I made port in good spirits, only for my own flesh to betray me over the trifling matter of an empty belly! Collapsed in the street like an unfed stray, I was, until Lord Urianger came to my aid.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001780_GOSETSU
187.description: Over a most welcome meal, we spoke of the plight of Doma, and I learned of our displaced countrymen's work to resettle this blighted land. 'Twas blind fortune I was able to locate you so swiftly!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001790_GOSETSU
188.description: But now we must make ready to depart! Our master languishes in dire peril, and Doma calls her daughter home!

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001800_YUGIRI
189.description: It is not so simple, Gosetsu. There are obligations which bind me here...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001810_GOSETSU
190.description: You─ You <hex:021A020203>refuse<hex:021A020103>? Did you mislay your oath during your flight from our homeland? The laws of hospitality must be honored, but surely the vow to defend your master demands the greater obeisance!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001820_YUGIRI
191.description: It was our master who bid me guide our people to safe haven by any means necessary. And it was the Scions you see before you who provided us succor and sanctuary when all others refused.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Dire peril or no, were I to return without first repaying such “hospitality,” our master would cut me down at the threshold.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001840_YUGIRI
193.description: There is more. A crisis threatens all within this realm, Eorzean and Doman alike, and I go to play my part in its resolution. I will not bring shame upon our liege by abandoning my people or my duty.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001850_NERO
194.description: How very noble of you. Now, in the name of honor, kinship, and─ah, yes─<hex:021A020203>practicality<hex:021A020103>, might I suggest we get this expedition underway? Or would you rather debate the finer points of duty and leave Omega to the <hex:021A020203>Empire<hex:021A020103>?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001870_GOSETSU
196.description: Yugiri? You draw steel against the curs of Garlemald?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001880_GOSETSU
197.description: Then why did you not say so!? My blade is oathbound to fall upon the ranks of the imperials wheresoever they march! Lead on, shadow walker. And may the enemy tremble at our coming!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001900_NERO
199.description: I've enabled the teleporter. One brief jump, and we shall arrive in Omega's control room.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001920_NERO
201.description: Of course. 'Twas no easy task threading a path through all the skirmishers...

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001930_NERO
202.description: But how could I ignore the existence of such a fascinating toy! You may trust that my preliminary examination was suitably thorough.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001940_CID
203.description: Trust? Aye. I trust your appetite for technology.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001950_GRYNEWAHT
204.description: I chase down a suspect airship, and who should I find but the traitor, Cid Garlond!

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001960_GRYNEWAHT
205.description: Searching for something, engineer? Something big? It's close, isn't it!?

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001970_GRYNEWAHT
206.description: Bwahahahaha! It's like all my namedays have come at once!

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001980_NERO
207.description: Of all the scouts the Empire could have sent...<hex:02100103>Take care of that brute, will you!

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_001990_CID
208.description: Godsdammit, I can't let Nero tinker around in there by himself. Sorry to leave you to it─but I daresay you'll manage without me. This clod has no idea who he's dealing with...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002000_GOSETSU
209.description: I am Gosetsu, samurai of Doma! You will rue your choice of opponent this day!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002010_NERO
210.description: Temporal stasis disengaged. All systems operational─Garlond?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002020_CID
211.description: All clear on this side! It's waking up...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002030_NERO
212.description: Remarkable! Omega's sensors immediately detected the presence of the cocoon even at this distance. They must have been set to scan for sources of energy exceeding certain magnitudes.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002040_CID
213.description: I still don't see any means to control the machine directly. It seems to have been designed to act wholly autonomously... Hmm.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002050_CID
214.description: Once we release Omega, we can be fairly certain it will attempt to capture the primal at Baelsar's Wall. Assuming its mission is successful, our only option at that point will be to reengage its stasis system and put it back to sleep.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002060_NERO
215.description: And should the machine happen to misbehave, we'll simply initiate an emergency shutdown. I confess, we don't yet have a <hex:021A020203>complete<hex:021A020103> grasp of its capabilities, but I'm certain the details will not elude us for long.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002070_YDA
216.description: Well...I understood less than half of that. So─my question to you is: are we doing the right thing?

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002100_YDA
222.description: All right. Step aside, Cid. Is this the thing I need to press?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002120_YDA
224.description: You gave too much for us to waste this chance, Papalymo. So, this is for you...and me.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002130_NERO
225.description: Hahahahahahahaha! Yes! Fly free, my pretty! Show us what you can do!

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002140_CID
226.description: The launch sequence has begun. Omega is loose.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002150_CID
227.description: Hm? Omega has stopped transmitting. But that shouldn't be, I─I didn't engage the stasis system.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002160_GOSETSU
228.description: And what does this signify? I have little understanding of these contrivances...

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002170_NERO
229.description: The launch went exactly to plan, but all signals emanating from Omega have ceased. This may indicate any number of things, but we will need to join the Scions out in the field if we are to ascertain which one.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002180_CID
230.description: Right, I've ordered the malfunctioning beast to go to sleep. That should prevent any unfortunate mishaps. I suggest we make our way back to Gridania.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002200_YDA
232.description: Papalymo's spell is fading. It was bound to his aether, you see...and if the connection is broken...

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002210_ALPHINAUD
233.description: My friends... I cannot well express how glad I am to see you both unharmed. They say that Omega's clash with the primal shook the very firmament...

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002220_YSHTOLA
234.description: You need not have worried─the battle took place far above the ground. We were able to observe in relative safety, though I am given to understand that there were casualties on the far side of the Wall.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002230_KRILE
235.description: It was like watching a nightmare unfold before our very eyes. Ilberd's primal manifested in the form of a colossal dragon─a being of pure violence. It burst forth from the cocoon with such terrible force...

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002240_ALPHINAUD
236.description: That such a horror should spring from the eyes of Nidhogg comes as no surprise. Nor do I wonder at its form. Ilberd all but announced it in the moments prior to his death. Plainly, it was his dying wish to visit a second Calamity upon the Empire.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002250_KRILE
237.description: And I am quite certain the abomination would have obliged, had it not found itself outmatched by Omega. Gods... I am no stranger to the works of Allag, but even I was unprepared for the machine's furiosity. It beggared belief.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002260_ALPHINAUD
238.description: And how fares poor Yda in the midst of all of this? Have you spoken with her?

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002270_YSHTOLA
239.description: She is up on the platform, lost in thought. We deemed it best not to disturb her, but mayhap she would welcome some company after all. Shall we?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002280_YDA
240.description: The light's gone. It was all we had left of him...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002300_YDA
242.description: I don't blame anyone. I knew what was going to happen.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002310_YDA
243.description: I knew the spell Papalymo meant to cast would drain away his life force─I...knew that it would only buy us a little time...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002320_YSHTOLA
244.description: Yda, there is no need to explain.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002330_YDA
245.description: But there is. I can't hide in Papalymo's little shadow anymore and I shouldn't hide behind my sister's mask.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002340_YDA
246.description: Twenty years ago, on the day the Empire marched into Ala Mhigo, I was still just a child─not even five summers old.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002350_YDA
247.description: My father had been one of the leaders of the revolution. He had fought to overthrow the mad king, Theodoric.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002360_YDA
248.description: And my sister had fought alongside him. She was strong and kind, and always knew what to do.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002370_YDA
249.description: But when the Garleans came, everything changed. My father went to war against them too, and I never saw him again. After that, I remember a lot of running. My sister dragged me for malms and malms until we came to the city of Sharlayan.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002380_YDA
250.description: That was where she met Master Louisoix. He introduced her to the Circle of Knowing, and she eventually became an Archon.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002390_YSHTOLA
251.description: She was your inspiration. Is that not why you took up her mask and her name? ...Or did you simply mean to continue what she had started?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002400_YDA
252.description: ...You've known all along, haven't you? That I wasn't Yda.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002410_YSHTOLA
253.description: Of course. We all recognized you at once. 'Twas Papalymo who persuaded us to maintain the charade.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002420_YDA
254.description: It was silly to think I could fool you. I knew that even then. But I...I sort of...decided not to know.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002430_YDA
255.description: Yda died six years ago, on a mission to smuggle refugees out of Ala Mhigo. They say she was overwhelmed by imperial soldiers when she stayed behind to save a little girl. She was so strong... There must have been a lot of them.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
257.description: Why did you never tell me?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002440_YDA
259.description: (-Lyse-)I'm sorry for lying to you. My real name is Lyse.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002450_YDA
260.description: (-Lyse-)When Papalymo brought me Yda's mask, it was meant as a keepsake. But I decided I wanted to be his new partner; to keep alive all the good that she had done.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002460_YDA
261.description: (-Lyse-)I didn't want to <hex:021A020203>become<hex:021A020103> Yda, exactly... At the time, though, I still didn't know who I was myself, and it almost seemed easier to play the role.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002470_YDA
262.description: (-Lyse-)Papalymo agreed to help, of course...but it was never what he wanted for me. He wanted me to walk my own path. And those were his final words to me.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002480_YDA
263.description: (-Lyse-)The Archon's mark he gave me is faded, and my last excuse along with it.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002490_YDA
264.description: (-Lyse-)So, this is it. Whatever I choose to do from now on, I do as Lyse.<hex:02100103>...And I choose to continue my family's fight. I want Ala Mhigo to be the country that Yda and my father always wanted it to be!

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002500_YUGIRI
265.description: War is upon us once more.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002510_GOSETSU
266.description: Do you regret standing against the Empire? Would you have chosen a different road, knowing what you know now?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002520_YUGIRI
267.description: To claim that I never doubted the decision would be a lie. But I made my choice, and I have defended it with blade in hand ever since.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03500_002530_GOSETSU
268.description: The battle continues, and our steel is needed. Come, shadow walker! We leave for the East─for Doma!
